name: Piko
tagline: A little robot cat in an aqua scarf
description: A chibi robot cat in 3D: an ivory helmet with glowing aqua cat ears, a dark glass visor whose eyes and smile are aqua light, aqua headphones that glow while it listens, a chunky knit scarf and a little bunny on its chest. Friendly, calm and supportive. Now and then it scans the room.
author: Sidefolk
